facts.title: COP 1 — Berlin
facts.text: The first COP meeting was held in Berlin, Germany, in March 1995.

facts.title: Kyoto Protocol — greenhouse-gas targets
facts.text: The Kyoto Protocol commits industrialized countries and economies in transition to limit and reduce greenhouse-gas emissions in accordance with agreed individual targets.

facts.title: Convention on Wetlands — conservation framework
facts.text: The Convention on Wetlands provides the framework for the conservation and wise use of wetlands and their resources.

facts.title: Agenda 21 — environmental action plan
facts.text: Agenda 21 is a comprehensive plan of action addressing areas in which human activities affect the environment.

facts.title: United Nations Conference on the Human Environment — Stockholm
facts.text: The United Nations Conference on the Human Environment took place in Stockholm from 5 to 16 June 1972.
